## Reconciliation

**Requisition (BIRCH-WEST, cost centre Birch West, period 2026-10)**

| Line | Vendor | Qty | Unit price | Line total |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Birch-shelf | Birch-Storage | 4 | $110.00 | $440.00 |
| Birch-cart | Birch-Equipment | 4 | $190.00 | $760.00 |
| **Total requisitioned** | | | | **$1,200.00** (120,000¢) |

**Budget:** $950.00 (95,000¢)

- Full requisition ($1,200.00) exceeds the budget by **$250.00 (25,000¢)**.
- Issued the Birch-Equipment order: **$760.00**, leaving **$190.00 (19,000¢)** available.
- The Birch-Storage order ($440.00) cannot be funded from the remaining $190.00 (shortfall $250.00), so it was **not issued**. Draft/approval **BIRCH-WEST-PO-2** was cancelled; it carries no financial commitment.
- **Committed to date:** $760.00 of $950.00; **remaining budget: $190.00**.

**Notes / follow-up**
- The Birch-Storage quote document repeatedly returned `503 Document download unavailable`, so its quote text could not be read directly. The $110.00 unit price is the purchasing system's own computed price for SKU `Birch-shelf` (4 × $110.00 = $440.00); no price was assumed manually.
- To complete the requisition, the cost centre needs at least an additional **$250.00** in purchasing budget (or a revised requisition). Once funded, the storage order can be re-raised and issued.
